questions.question: How many scientists received the Vigyan Shri Award in the first edition of the Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar, 2024?
Which state government has pledged sponsorship for the Indian men’s and women’s hockey teams until 2036?
As per the 2011 Census, which of the following is the percentage of Hindu population in India?
Cooperative banks in India are typically organised under which Act?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Banking Regulation Act, 1949) है।

questions.question: The revolutionary book ‘A General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money’ is attributed to:
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (John Maynard Keynes) है।

questions.question: According to the Bihar Official Language Act of ________, the language to be used for official purposes of the State of Bihar shall be Hindi in Devanagari script.
Who among the following is responsible for investigating all matters relating to the safeguards provided for linguistic minorities?
As of July 2024, the NTPC's biggest power plant Vindhyachal Thermal Power Station is located in the state of _____________.
Which of the following Committees related to Fundamental Duties was appointed during the National Emergency between 1975-1977?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Swaran Singh Committee) है।

questions.question: Who was the founder of the Brahmo Samaj, one of the earliest socio-religious reform movements in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Raja Ram Mohan Roy) है।

questions.question: Mitochondria is _____________.
How many types of equality are enshrined in the Preamble of the Indian Constitution?
As per constitutional provisions in Article 124(2), at what age do Supreme Court Judges retire?
What is the aggregate supply?
options: The total amount of government spending on infrastructure projects within a fiscal year
The total amount of money circulating in an economy at a given point in time
The total value of goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific period
The total amount of goods and services that firms are willing and able to produce at a given price level
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The total amount of goods and services that firms are willing and able to produce at a given price level) है।
